Title: How to Turn a Side Project Into a Community
Desc: Learn how developers can grow a simple side project into an active community by focusing on users, feedback loops, open communication, and consistent engagement.
Author: MyWrite
Data:
## Most side projects start like this:

```text
Idea
↓
Code
↓
Launch
↓
No Users
```

The missing piece is usually not code.

It’s people.

A project becomes a **community** when users start interacting, contributing, and shaping it.

---

## What Makes a Project a Community?

A side project is:

* Built by you
* Used by others

A community project is:

* Shaped by users
* Improved by feedback
* Driven by shared ownership

Flow:

```text id="community-flow"
Users
↔
Project
↔
Contributor Growth
```

---
